purpose: Measure whether 20-sample online checks and a mandatory 20-sample post-candidate challenge can revoke early stopping before shifted noise creates wrong drift decisions.

pilot.note: Pilot examined before freeze and excluded from holdout; SG037_challenge20 selected on pilot.

frozen_controller.predecision: SG034 calibration risk gate budget .08 based on t0..109 only, unchanged calibration Wilson bins.
frozen_controller.alarm: Detrend last 80 acquired observations via least-squares, trigger if residual lag-1 autocorrelation > .78 or residual RMS > .29; latch alarm and use fixed240 decision.
frozen_controller.candidate: At t>=120 acquired observations, require same strong non-unresolved trend status at two adjacent 20-observation checkpoints; strong means |slope|>.0036 (confirm) or |slope|<.0014 (reject).
frozen_controller.challenge: After candidate, collect 20 more observations; commit only if label remains same, strong, and no alarm occurred. Invalidate candidate on mismatch. At 240 always use full-budget label.
comparators: SG036 40-sample checkpoints with no mandatory challenge
frozen_controller.timing: Shift onset known only to evaluator (continuation t0 or t60); record first alarm, candidate time, commitment time, and detection lag. Agent never accesses onset before decision.

limitations: Synthetic known families; no out-of-distribution guarantee
Monitoring latency intrinsically at least 80 acquired points for first window
Late shift can happen after early irreversible stop; no zero-risk guarantee
Pilot-tuned thresholds and confirmation window; holdout tests those choices, not arbitrary ones
